name: Vice City retro easter egg
summary: A long puzzle built on GTA: Vice City's cheat codes that opens a portal to a PS2-era area.
body: Start at the radio tower in Key Lento: a switch near the top, a lever on the power box, then the switchboard button. A neon Malibu sign shows it is running.

Visit 12 substations in order without fast travel, auto-drive, getting busted or dying: Downtown Vice City, Balsero, Key Lento, Penmarch Isle, Crosstown, Port Gellhorn, Hamlet, Gloriana Key, Hamlet, Gellhorn, Hamlet and North Mariana County. Their letters spell LIFE IS PASSING ME BY, a Vice City cheat.
A text from "Unknown" gives a reactor code. Between 7 PM and 6 AM, pull the lever at Reactor 2 of the T.H. Power Station east of Hamlet to open the portal.
Inside is Kent Paul. The rewards are Tommy Vercetti's Hawaiian shirt and the Malibu Zombie Bobber motorcycle.
